title: Building Ward
lede: Ashfall is being built one district at a time, starting with Ward. This page tracks what has been made so far, what the build looks like today and what comes next.
buildLine: Current build: native Linux development build, 1 October 2026 · Unity 6

playableTitle: What you can do in the build today
playableIntro: Everything in this list works in the 1 October build. It is one district and a field area outside its walls, not a whole game.
playable: Start at the West Gate and walk Ward: the avenue, the hill stairs and the oasis tree, the market, the shops, the greenhouses and the walls. Jump, and zoom from third person into first person.
Talk to four townspeople, each with branching dialogue and objectives.
Trade at the general store: buy parts and supplies, and sell salvage.
Learn the scrap pistol at the Warden training range, then head into the Outer Berms for salvage caches, scrap heaps, field orders and a tough depot elite.
Fit grip, barrel and power-cell mods to the pistol at the field fabricator.
Open an early character sheet: attributes, skills, implant and armour slots, weapon loadouts and carry weight.
See Ward by day and by night: lamps, signs and terminals switch on with the city's light clock (for now the time of day is set from a developer menu), with music, ambience and spatial sound.
Save and Continue. Reduced motion is built in, and menus and panels work from the keyboard (camera look, zoom and aiming still use the mouse).
timelineIntro: Dated from the project's own records. Work paused from 11 to 25 September.

timeline.label: 7 Sep
timeline.title: First walkable prototype
timeline.body: A greybox city with townspeople to talk to, a shop and a travel link screen. The same day the city moved into Unity and ran as a native Linux build with dialogue, trading, the link screen and a HUD.

timeline.label: 8–10 Sep
timeline.title: A first look for Ward
timeline.body: Facades, materials and weathering for the first district, the hill courtyard, and design sheets for Karaveen market stalls.

timeline.label: 26–28 Sep
timeline.title: Dust, caravans and the Outer Berms
timeline.body: Dust-bowl atmosphere, the Karaveen caravan market, retrofitted greenhouses, West Gate work, the Outer Berms field area and the player character's movement and feel.

timeline.label: 29 Sep
timeline.title: Things to do outside the wall
timeline.body: Crafting arrives with a field fabricator. The scrap pistol gets three mod slots, seeded loot, salvage caches, scrap heaps, field orders and the depot elite. Long sun shadows and a new sky.

timeline.label: 30 Sep
timeline.title: Save games and Vanguard Hall
timeline.body: Save, autosave and Continue, and temporal anti-aliasing. Layered desert terrain, visible pistol mods and the field pack. Vanguard Hall is rebuilt from its accepted concept, followed by the hall district shops and the hill and tree ring.

timeline.label: 1 Oct
timeline.title: A day of world building
timeline.body: Perimeter walls with old battle damage, planted greenhouses, the Warden training range, night lighting and ambient life, eroded mountains, stone paving, timber gates on the spawn arches, rooftops, wind-blown sand and shade sails, plus an early character sheet. A full test of the merged build followed: 195 tests passing, the city and range routes playable start to finish, and 270 review captures. Late that evening a walk-in Salvage shop, with a dealer called Brann and his workbench, went into testing.

passesCaption: Each bar is a dated art, world or tech pass in the project (43 in all); the line is the running total. Gameplay systems are counted in the timeline, not here.
pairsIntro: Concept art sets a target; the build is judged against it at player height. Each pair shows the concept and the same place in the 1 October build.

pairs.title: Vanguard Hall
pairs.body: The accepted concept set the target: a battered sandstone civic hall with corner piers, barred windows and a bronze nameplate. The hall in the build was authored to match it, then weathered with the same stone kit as the rest of Ward.

pairs.title: The hall district shops
pairs.body: The street in front of the hall. The build follows the concept's stone, recessed doors and lamps; its shop signs were replaced with a new sign family.

pairs.title: The West Gate
pairs.body: The concept for the way out of Ward to the Outer Berms. The build took its stencilled lintel sign, knee braces and hazard-striped piers.

pairs.title: The Outer Berms depot
pairs.body: The ruined depot at the end of the Berms road, where the salvage caches and the depot elite are found.

pairs.title: Karaveen market stalls
pairs.body: Stalls were first drawn as front, side and back sheets, and one was built to measure from them; the market's stalls were later rebuilt by hand. Alongside, a pottery stall in the market today.

galleryIntro: Captured from the 1 October development build at midday and at night. These are work in progress: the HUD and some place names are working labels, and most of these places are still waiting for review.
roadmapIntro: The production plan, in order. There are no dates: each stage is finished when it holds up in play, not on a calendar.

roadmap.name: Quality baseline
roadmap.body: Record the district as it stands, agree the visual references and list the gaps.

roadmap.name: A representative street
roadmap.body: Bring one street, its doorways, ground, props and lighting up to the target together, judged at player height.

roadmap.name: Hero landmarks
roadmap.body: The hill tree, the gates, Vanguard Hall and the skyline. The first rebuilds are in and waiting for review.

roadmap.name: District rollout
roadmap.body: Carry the accepted standard across Ward: walls, greenhouses, roofs, paving and working yards.

roadmap.name: Characters and life
roadmap.body: Distinct faces, clothes and silhouettes for the townspeople, natural idles, turns and walks, and townsfolk with somewhere to be.

roadmap.name: Presentation and polish
roadmap.body: Light, shadow, image stability, the sound mix and the interface pulled together, at 60 fps or better on the test machine.

roadmap.name: The first full gameplay slice
roadmap.body: One bounded loop of survival, combat and settlement from the design. The Outer Berms loop is an early step; the Lattice, companions and recovery come after.

rough: The four townspeople share one placeholder guard model for now. Distinct characters are planned.
Idle and talking poses are static; animation is early.
Most of the 30 September and 1 October rebuilds are still waiting for art review and may change.
Some HUD and place names are working labels.
Night can stutter once, the first time some lamps switch on. It is being investigated.
The greenhouses and shops can't be entered yet. A walk-in Salvage shop is in testing.
The ring in the Lattice court opens a link screen; travelling through it isn't playable.
next: Play through the 1 October build and fix what review turns up.
Finish Brann's walk-in Salvage shop and tie it into the first field order.
Smooth out the night stutter and the busiest street view.
Give the four townspeople their own faces, clothes and animation.
Keep this page and the in-build gallery current as the build moves.
